quality_gate: Five-article frozen batches; whole Chinese source plus full foreign prose and all apparatus read by a different editor; precise source adjudication and complete saved field reread; genuinely frozen complete shared metadata before strict approval/seal. Counts and hashes do not replace literary reading.
source_reading: Lead actually read all thirty complete current Chinese essays (595 argument paragraphs), every full selected-version note and all 46 exact source references/labels, plus the complete Chinese index, six groups and six entry doors. C separately read all thirty and all apparatus. This is not a new full external collation of all source books.
preservation: Fixed pre-expansion whole HTML, original English body and description-tag archive, full Chinese/Hant blocks and original index. Narrow recorded link repairs precede baseline. Authorized English article-body replacement includes precise reviewed English description/og:description corrections so search snippets do not contradict the full essay. Matching original English index-card descriptions may synchronize these same reviewed decks, retaining story-name prefixes; exact old tags/paragraphs and owned markers make both independently reversible. Language controls are reversible. Publication UI language counts on the original index may be updated through separately reversible count markers; titles, URLs and original Chinese argumentative and introductory prose remain untouched.
search_metadata: Three primary reading modes reuse their own existing index/card descriptions as hidden search metadata outside the reading prose. Upgraded English article descriptions use the reviewed complete-English deck. Owned markers remove this metadata byte-exactly for the fixed original-HTML preservation check; Chinese/Traditional reading content is not rewritten.
deployment: Separate local commit after complete review/QA; no push. Stop after laughter and fairy-tales.
